LanguageData.TTG_PastureZoneDesc: Designate a pasture: an open grazing area outside a pen. Link it to a pen in the pen marker's "Grazing" tab, and handlers will lead hungry animals here to graze and bring them back.
LanguageData.TTG_PastureNotLinked: Not linked to any pen (use the pen marker's "Grazing" tab).
LanguageData.TTG_EnableDesc: When the start conditions are met, handlers rope the herd, lead it to a linked pasture and bring it back when the return conditions are met.
LanguageData.TTG_NoPastureLinkedHint: No pastures linked. Draw a "Pasture" zone (Zones menu) and link it below.
LanguageData.TTG_PastureRowTip: The herd goes to the linked pasture with the most grass, so several pastures rotate and get time to regrow.\n\nDays are estimated for the animals currently in the pen.
LanguageData.TTG_NoPasturesOnMap: No unlinked pastures on this map
LanguageData.TTG_TriggerHungerDesc: Start grazing when any animal in the herd is below the fullness threshold.
LanguageData.TTG_TriggerPenFoodDesc: Start grazing when grass and stockpiled food in the pen would last fewer days than the threshold.
LanguageData.TTG_UseScheduleDesc: Only graze within these hours; the herd is brought back when they end.
LanguageData.TTG_ScheduleOnlyNote: No start condition selected: the herd goes out once a day during grazing hours.
LanguageData.TTG_ReturnOnDangerDesc: Raids, predators hunting the herd, toxic fallout or haze, and temperatures unsafe for the animals. Also prevents going out in such conditions.
LanguageData.TTG_ExcludeSick: Keep sick and injured animals in the pen
LanguageData.TTG_ExcludePregnant: Keep pregnant animals in the pen
LanguageData.TTG_ExcludeYoung: Keep young animals in the pen
LanguageData.TTG_ShepherdDesc: The shepherd leads the herd out first and then stands watch for the whole grazing (urgent Handling work during work hours). Wandering off and predator attacks become much rarer; better Animals skill is better. The shepherd may chase off predators.
LanguageData.TTG_DogDesc: An animal trained in "Herding" stays close to the grazing herd, keeps it together and attacks predators that go after it.
LanguageData.TTG_GuardsHint: Without guards any colonist with Handling work leads the herd, and the herd grazes unattended.
LanguageData.TTG_Status_Counts: Waiting to be led out: {0}, grazing: {1}, waiting to return: {2}
LanguageData.TTG_StartNowDesc: Take the herd out to the pasture right now, ignoring start conditions and hours.
LanguageData.TTG_ReturnNowDesc: Bring the grazing herd back to the pen now.
LanguageData.TTG_NoPastureLinked: No pasture linked to this pen.
LanguageData.TTG_Reason_Predator: a predator is hunting the herd
LanguageData.TTG_Msg_Started: Pen "{0}": the herd is going out to pasture "{1}" ({2} animals).
LanguageData.TTG_Msg_Wandered: {0} wandered off from the herd of pen "{1}".
LanguageData.TTG_Msg_PredatorHunting: {0} is hunting {1} from the herd of pen "{2}"!
LanguageData.TTG_Msg_DogDefends: {0} rushes at {1} to protect the herd.
LanguageData.TTG_Msg_NoCandidates: No animals in this pen can go grazing.
LanguageData.TTG_Msg_NoPasture: No reachable linked pasture with grass.
LanguageData.TTG_ShepherdLeadsFirst: {0} is the shepherd and leads the herd first
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_RoamDesc: Multiplier on the vanilla chance that an animal outside a pen wanders off the map. Shepherd values are for Animals skill 10.
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_PredatorsDesc: Multiplier on the chance that a predator picks a grazing animal as prey.
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_SkillScaling: Shepherd effect scales with Animals skill
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_SkillScalingDesc: Skill 10 gives the configured values; lower skill is weaker, higher is stronger.
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_RepelDesc: A herding dog attacks a predator hunting the herd; a shepherd may scare it away (chance grows with Animals skill).
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_Thought: Shepherd mood bonus "quiet day at the pasture"
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_Messages: Messages when the herd goes out and comes back
LanguageData.TTG_Settings_MinHours: Minimum time at pasture before "everyone is fed" returns the herd: {0} h
